title: Davidson L6 SVC balanced split-stability audit
question: M1.46 的唯一 5/5 格是 Davidson L6 SVC balanced f32 的 macro-F1 +6.8989pp，但该 5/5 只是同一组 test 预测的 5 次 bootstrap 重采样，不是独立拟合。把 Davidson 的 train/test 重新独立切分后，这个 balanced−unweighted 差值是否仍然稳定为正？
scope: single cell audit; descriptive split-stability, not candidate confirmatory

dataset.name: Davidson et al. 2017 hate speech and offensive language
dataset.note: M1.45 exported 24,781 rows after deduplication and removal of the one normalized-text overlap row with TweetEval/hate and HateXplain. All 24,781 rows are eligible here.

splits.independence_note: Each split is a separate partition draw from the same corpus. They are independent split draws, not independent corpora or independent samples; test sets overlap across draws.
splits.original_m145_split_used_for: only as the source of the 24,781-row cleaned table and embeddings

modeling.threshold_note: default LinearSVC decision boundary; fixed before scoring, no threshold search
modeling.class_weight: balanced only for the balanced rule, estimated from fit labels
modeling.c_selection: per split: unweighted f32 fit only, 5-fold StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True, random_state=7), accuracy; the selected C is shared by both rules within that split
modeling.test_usage: test labels and test scores are not used for C selection, threshold selection, or rule selection

primary.bootstrap: 10,000 paired test-level bootstrap resamples within each split, 95% two-sided percentile CI
primary.bootstrap_note: The five split rows are the independent fitting units. The bootstrap RNG seeds only quantify within-split sampling noise; they are not model seeds and must not be counted as independent confirmations.

verdict_rule.supported: at least 4/5 splits have point_delta > 0 and ci_low > 0, and the mean point_delta across the 5 splits is > 0
verdict_rule.directional: at least 3/5 splits have point_delta > 0 and mean point_delta > 0, but the supported condition is not met

primary.interpretation_limit: Even if supported, this only establishes split-stability of one descriptive cell on one corpus. It does not reopen M1.46's candidate line, does not validate a deployable rule, and does not turn Davidson into an official-split benchmark.

secondary: per-split absolute accuracy, macro-F1, hate/non-hate recall, predicted positive rate, and selected C
per-split point-delta sign and bootstrap verdict counts
test hate prior and predicted positive rate drift
exclusions: no target_prior, fit-prior quantile, calibration, or threshold search
no new corpus, re-encoding, MLP, or fine-tuning
no reuse of the M1.46 test partition as a primary split
gate_note: If any split has zero hate rows in test, that split is invalid and must be reported as invalid; do not repair it after seeing scores.
